One of Diljit's most iconic anthems! 5 Taara by Diljit Dosanjh — out on Speed Records.
With Diljit Dosanjh's signature swagger, music by Jatinder Shah and lyrics by Ranbir Singh, 5 Taara became one of the biggest Punjabi hits of its time — a full-attitude anthem that still gets everyone going. Starring Diljit Dosanjh & Tris Dhaliwal. Turn it up!
Speed Records proudly presents Diljit Dosanjh's brand new track "5 TAARA"
